newsitem.title: USA: Performance names Hatamyar interim CFO.
newsitem.headline: Performance names Hatamyar interim CFO.

text.p: Performance Nutrition Inc said on Wednesday that it named William Hatamyar as interim chief financial officer.
Hatamyar will assist the company's new management in its overview of the accuracy of financial statements for the fiscal years ended September 30, 1995 and 1996.

On August 29, 1996, the company's board was expanded from five to eleven members. Gary Lewellyn was removed as the company's chairman, chief executive officer and president. Tamara Halling was removed as secretary and treasurer.

The company's new management has initiated an investigation into the conduct of prior management and the accuracy of its financial statements for the fiscal years ended September 30,1995, and for the nine moth period ended June 30, 1996, it said previously.
Currently, present management has been unable to verify the accuracy of the company's financial statements.
